description: Lists the valid values for search_catalog's category filter, with counts. Use it before filtering a search by category; use search_catalog itself to find items. kind templates (default) returns AnimatedWebs template categories under categories (fixed display order, zero-count categories included, some with a description) and the template kinds website, section and background under kinds; kind components returns UI library categories with component and variant counts under componentCategories (only non-empty ones); kind all returns both. Backgrounds, styles and creators have no categories. No pagination. Read-only. Example: {"kind":"components"}.

kind.description: templates (default): template categories and template kinds. components: UI library categories. all: both.

scope.description: Deprecated name for kind, still accepted. kind wins when both are sent.

name: list_categories

componentCategories.description: UI library categories (kind components or all)

kinds.description: Template kinds website, section and background (kind templates or all)

title: List AnimatedWebs categories
